review: Front, reverse, edge and oblique plots from actual-loader geometry inspected. Native scale and sourcecomponent coverage retained. Exact variant selections and estimated geometry boundaries are recorded in each modelplan. No WebGL, optical/material or hardware-fit acceptance.
imageScope: CPU geometry-only review. Images do not demonstrate firmware output or browser texture decoding.

waveshare-p4-wifi6-db-m-mechanical: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
This asset depicts the exact retained manufacturer assembly. Materials and unidentified component semantics are approximate; dimensions and all native relative placements remain unscaled.

Packaged cameras, external display, speaker, PoE add-on, antenna cables and other optional accessories absent from sourceCAD are not fabricated as included geometry. Exact packaging remains in product knowledge.
BOOT uses a verified product input control where present. No GPIO hit target is placed on an uncalibrated native component; bare modules do not gain a nonexistent button or codec.
No Ethernet/radio/DSI/CSI/analog hardware or firmware execution is established by this mechanical model.

Retained native source is the printed-antenna, header-free mainboard. -M headers are separate declared estimates; -U/-UM omit the source radio module and retain an UNKNOWN external-antenna module envelope instead of silently reusing the printed antenna.
Exact-M header and-U externalantenna assemblies are chosen separately from nativebare/printedantennaCAD. Omit sourceC5radiomodule653 for-U; preserve the remaining656nativecomponents.
Solderedheaders use sourcecount/pitch and explicit estimatedsection/length. ManufacturerbareboardCAD contains no headers; no fake headerCAD is attributed to the source.
